title: English Practice Quiz 0833
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Legal and Compliance Awareness 01: A compliance requirement is:
options: An obligation arising from law, regulation or policy
questions.explanation: The first option is correct. It follows the relevant professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Legal and Compliance Awareness 02: An employee who receives a legal notice should:
options: Refer it promptly to the authorised department
questions.explanation: The first option is correct. It follows the relevant professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Legal and Compliance Awareness 03: An official register should be maintained:
questions.explanation: The first option is correct. It follows the relevant professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Legal and Compliance Awareness 06: An inspection record should be:
questions.explanation: The first option is correct. It follows the relevant professional practice or standard English usage.
